{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify the six QA rows: those with revenue = '999,999.99'
qa_rows = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999,999.99']

# Count how many such rows
num_qa = len(qa_rows)
print(f"Number of QA rows (with revenue '999,999.99'):")
print(num_qa)

# Confirm they are all marked as completed
print("\nStatus of QA rows:")
print(qa_rows['status'].value_counts())

# Count total completed orders (including QA)
total_completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]

# Subtract QA rows to get actual completed orders
actual_completed = total_completed - num_qa

print(f"\nTotal completed (including QA): {total_completed}")
print(f"Actual completed (excluding QA): {actual_completed}")"}
